actions: Deploy NAS security event monitoring with a threshold of 3 failed EMM state transitions per device per hour.
Enable 5G NAS integrity protection with NAS security mode extension (NSSF) enforcement.
Configure RAN to block unregistered MME/AMF IPs for NAS signaling with a 5-second timeout.
Implement NAS trace filtering to drop all EMM state 128eea1 traces from unknown eNB/gNBs.
Set NAS security context validation rules requiring pre-authentication for non-home networks.
Enable 5G NAS replay attack detection with a 10-message window for duplicate NAS messages.
Restrict NAS EMM state transitions to authorized states (e.g., 128eea1 → 128eea2) only.
Deploy NAS anomaly scoring with a score > 0.9 flagging for manual review.
Update RAN to enforce NAS security mode 3 for all UE attachments.
Monitor NAS EMM state 128eea1 occurrences per UE, alerting if exceeding 1 per 24 hours.

mapped_mitigations.fgm_name: Discard RAN Signaling Received Without Integrity Protection
Cross Check Between Application Layer And Transport Layer
